status: DRAFT - for Plumber hash, then Matt lock | v3 (Plumber fixes); v2 applies Matt 11:32 PT decisions

framing.novelty: day-level adherence (meditation vs non-meditation days within person) is not analysed in Li et al. 2021 (Note 2026-10-24e)

alignment.primary: previous_day: morning 'past 24 h' item on row t+1 describes diary day t
alignment.day20_rule: meditation for time 20 would come from row 21 (Period 3, structurally 0) -> set missing (confirmed Matt 11:32 PT)

H1_primary.estimand: fixed within-person meditation slope b_within on same-day SC (SD units)
H1_primary.decision_rule: supported if posterior P(b_within>0) >= .975 (Matt 11:32 PT 2026-10-24) AND convergence criteria met; report median, 90% and 95% CrI
H1_primary.reporting: median, 90% and 95% CrI, P(effect in hypothesised direction), P(effect beyond 0.2 SD in hypothesised direction), beside the .975 rule

H2_secondary.estimand: within-person meditation day t on EE day t+1, adjusted for EE day t (AR term)
H2_secondary.decision_rule: supported if P(b_within<0) >= .975 AND convergence met; secondary, no confirmatory claim if H1 fails
H2_secondary.reporting: median, 90% and 95% CrI, P(effect in hypothesised direction), P(effect beyond 0.2 SD in hypothesised direction), beside the .975 rule

model.centering: latent person-mean: meditation ~ Bernoulli(p_i), within part = m_it - p_i (Hamaker & Grasman 2015; Hamaker et al. 2018; Asparouhov, Hamaker & Muthen 2018)
model.ar: AR(1) on person-centred lagged outcome, common phi
model.person_covariates: none in primary (TSC, demographics not entered)
model.standardization: outcome z-scored on observed analysis-window values; meditation 0/1

priors.sensitivity: slope prior SD x2 (1.0) and x0.5 (0.25)

mcmc.divergences: 0 required; if >0 rerun at adapt_delta .99 and report
mcmc.ppc: posterior predictive checks of SC/EE distribution and lag-1 autocorrelation

missing_data.primary: MAR: missing outcomes as parameters in the joint likelihood; missing meditation days contribute no within-person information
missing_data.sensitivity: delta-adjusted pattern-mixture: missing SC shifted -0.25 and -0.50 SD (Matt-approved 11:32 PT); missing EE shifted +0.50 SD (Matt-approved 2026-10-24 11:53 PT: "Keep both defaults")
missing_data.exclusions: none; persons with zero no-meditation days are kept and their count reported
missing_data.li_exclusion_disclosure: Li et al. 2021 excluded participants with < 7 meditations; we disclose it and refit under it as S5 only

reliability.method: two-level CFA omega within and between (Geldhof, Preacher & Zyphur 2014), lavaan MLR

multiplicity.secondary: H2 reported with full posterior, labelled secondary; not combined with H1 into a family claim
multiplicity.additional_analyses: no decision thresholds; descriptive posteriors only (Rubin 2021)

sensitivity_list.S1: prior SD x2 / x0.5 on H1
sensitivity_list.S4: H2 under S1, S2 and delta +0.50 SD (EE +0.50 SD shift Matt-approved 2026-10-24 11:53 PT: "Keep both defaults"; sign -1)
sensitivity_list.S6: observed person-mean centering brms model (H1, sign +1); sensitivity only; specification Matt-approved 2026-10-24 11:53 PT: "Keep both defaults"

precision_statement: N = 65 persons; codebook shows 725 yes, 147 no, 38 missing meditation person-days in Period 2. With few no-days per person, the within-person slope will be imprecise; no power claim is made. Precision is reported as the 95% CrI width and posterior SD of b_within; a result is called inconclusive when the 95% CrI includes both 0 and |0.2| SD.

software.lavaan: 0.7-3 (deviation from 0.6.19: shared box library used by other projects; diary models are brms; lavaan only in R/03_omega.R)
software.lockfile: renv.lock generated by Blacksmith via renv::snapshot(type='implicit') on 2026-10-24, before any fit; hash to be recorded by Plumber

compute: light CPU, 2 parallel chains, local only
matt_decisions_2026-10-24_1132: Matt-approved (11:32 PT, "go with your suggestion"): P>=.975; SC pattern-mixture shifts -0.25/-0.50 SD; |0.2| SD inconclusive band; day 20 missing.

matt_decisions_2026-10-24_1153.S6_specification: Matt-approved 2026-10-24 11:53 PT: "Keep both defaults": brms, observed person-mean centering, SC z-scored, SC ~ med_wc + med_pm + WD + time_c + (1 + med_wc | ID) + ar(time, gr=ID, p=1), prior normal(0,0.5) on ALL class-b coefficients, 4 chains x 1000 warmup + 1000 sampling, adapt_delta .95, max_treedepth 12, seed from mcmc.seed
